MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.

2. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.

3. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

4. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.

5. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.

6. When practising Reading for Understanding, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Understanding.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Understanding.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Understanding.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Understanding.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
